overview.description: The iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond BuyWrite Strategy ETF (TLTW) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the CBOE TLT 2% OTM Buywrite index. The fund uses a fund-of-fund approach to passively track an index that measures the performance of holding shares of the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF and writes one-month, out-of-the-money call options against the shares. TLTW was launched on Aug 18, 2022 and is issued by BlackRock.
